title: Missing error when void functions return a value from another function
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.dev [220b0b2f7], 4.6.stable, and earlier versions.

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop - Intel i7-12700H (20 threads)

### Issue description

Normally, returning a value in a void function produces an error. However, returning a value from another function does not produce an error, which is inconsistent.

Note: It is syntactically correct to return void from another void function:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71169

### Steps to reproduce

Attach this script to a Node and run the scene.
Note: `void_B` and `void_C` behave the same, but are syntactically different.
```gdscript
extends Node

func get_1() -> int:
    return 1

#func void_A() -> void:
    #return 1 # Error: "A void function cannot return a value."

func void_B() -> void:
    return get_1() # No error, but syntactically wrong.

func void_C() -> void:
    get_1() # No error, syntactically correct.
    return

func _ready() -> void:
    #print(void_A.call())
    print(void_B.call()) # <null>
    print(void_C.call()) # <null>
```
